The check fails open (FR-TEST-HYG-010/012), and the test meant to guard the constant proves nothing.

True limitation of go list -deps (current GOOS/GOARCH and default tags only), but no file under cmd/ or internal/ has a //go:build constraint today, so nothing is missed now. Documenting it or widening the listing is an improvement.
title: Document or cover build-constrained files in the server dependency check
todo:
**Problem:** `listServerDependencies` (`internal/amazon/amazontest/server_dependencies.go:17`) runs `go list -deps ./cmd/...`, which only resolves files for the current GOOS/GOARCH and default build tags. A helper import in a build-constrained file (for example `//go:build windows` or `_darwin.go`) used by the server would be missed. No such files exist today.

**Suggested work:** Note the limitation in the doc comment of `listServerDependencies` and in TS-TEST-HYG-011 (`doc/specifications/test-suite-hygiene/technical.md`), or, if release targets differ, also run the listing for each release GOOS/GOARCH (and relevant `-tags`).

title: Split the `fails` field of the dependency check table tests
todo:
**Problem:** In `internal/amazon/amazontest/server_dependencies_test.go` the `fails` field (line 173, and line 81 for TC-002) mixes sentinels (`"dependency"`, `"listing"`) with free text a listing error must contain, and TC-002 and TC-003 use different sentinel sets under the same name. Row TC-003 g only checks for `main.go`.

**Suggested work:** Replace `fails` with an outcome enum (pass / dependency / listing) plus a separate `listErrHolds string`, or name the sentinel constants. Check for `main.go:3` in row g so the assertion is tied to the syntax error.

title: Simplify the cmd/pricefollower presence check in TestServerDoesNotDependOnTestHelper
todo:
